title: Binary entropy and distance from balance
statement: For every real number $p$ with $0\le p\le 1$, the binary entropy satisfies $1\le H(p)/\log 2+|2p-1|$, where $H(p)=-p\log p-(1-p)\log(1-p)$ with the usual endpoint convention.
